text.card: A red giant 1,052 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.83 solar masses and 20.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,393 K at its surface.
